description: A high-DOF humanoid robot featuring a head, arms with multi-axis joints, a waist, and bipedal legs for locomotion and interaction.
notes: The robot has full humanoid kinematics including arms and legs. While it has 'hand' links, there are no finger actuators listed in the actuator_names, suggesting the hands are fixed end-effectors (likely palms); therefore, can_grasp is set to false, but it can still support or push objects using the hand links. Evidence for lifting/tool use is inferred from the presence of multi-DOF arms (Shoulder Pitch/Roll, Elbow Pitch/Yaw).
